in_sanskrit.name: Anowar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anowar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anowar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anugha' meaning grace or help from God. It is a name bestowed upon those who seek divine protection and guidance.

in_marathi.name: Anowar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anowar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anowar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anugha' meaning grace or help from God. It is a name bestowed upon those who seek divine protection and guidance.
